evidence.quote: Furnish and install non-structural metal framing, gypsum board, shaft wall at elevator and mechanical shafts, taped and finished to Level 4 per Section 09 21 16.
Level 5 finish at two-story lobby per finish schedule. Sound attenuation batts at all partitions noted on A-601. In-wall blocking for casework and wall-mounted equipment per A-501 details.
Lifts and scaffolding for our work included. Daily cleanup of our debris to GC-provided dumpster included. Pricing assumes one mobilization per floor.
Exterior sheathing by others. Firestopping NIC. Acoustical ceilings NIC.
Alternate No. 1, Level 5 finish at all corridors: ADD $18,400.00.
Additional soffit/bulkhead, framed and finished: $42.00 per LF.
Base bid $842,500.00. Sales tax included. Performance and payment bond if required add 1.5%. Proposal valid 30 days from August 21, 2026.
